title: offer
description: An offer, at the path `offer/<id>`. Its body is defined by the market the profile lives in (foundationforest/markets). The standard names one field, media, because a host keeps the blobs a record names.

media.description: Optional. Photos and short videos of the work.
A photo or a short video, named by the SHA-256 of its bytes.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file, lowercase hex.

mimeType.description: The file's media type, type/subtype in lower case, such as image/jpeg. Which types to take is each host's own choice, and each reader's.

size.description: Bytes. How large a blob to take is each host's own choice, and each reader's.
